description: Asks what CInt, CLng and CByte return or raise for text operands: plain, padded, thousands-separated, exponent, hex (&H) and octal (&O) prefixed, trailing-garbage, empty, currency-symbol, parenthesised, internally spaced, signed, and a fullwidth-digit text. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
